name: Description list
summary: Label and value pairs on a <dl>, stacked or in two columns, with an optional action per row.
description: Use it for detail views and summaries: an order, an account, a server. Stacked suits narrow spaces; .v-dl-cols puts term and value side by side once the list is wide enough.

classes.name: v-dl
classes.description: On a <dl> whose rows are <div>s holding a <dt> and its <dd>, with a rule between rows. Stacked by default.

classes.name: v-dl-cols
classes.description: Term and value side by side once the list is at least 32rem wide (a container query).

classes.name: v-dl-action
classes.description: A last <dd> in a row for an edit link or copy button, aligned to the end.

a11y: Wrapping each <dt>/<dd> pair in a <div> is valid HTML and keeps the pairs together for screen readers.
Name actions with their row, e.g. a .v-sr-only "billing email" after "Change", when several rows have the same action.
Terms are smaller muted text but still meet 4.5:1 contrast.
